title: Current @orb/ui consumption-model audit for pnpm ast and Knip
head: 8f7ed4c4b98c112429c3918483f3a172f66ae184
mode: read-only; shared dirty worktree preserved; no repo edits, staging, commits, workboard mutation, or test suites

verdict.pnpmAst: The current @orb/ui consumption shapes are modeled correctly. Named imports, local aliases, named re-export barrels, JSX uses, registry/value references, same-file uses, CT-only imports, and statically named dynamic-import members resolve to origin declarations. Namespace imports deliberately err alive over the whole target surface; swallowed is the compensating candidate lens.
verdict.knip: Knip is not the authority for unused exports from @orb/ui entry barrels. The 94-subpath package exports map makes those targets entries, and includeEntryExports is disabled. The focused default run therefore returns zero issues even though AST proves three unused exports. Enabling entry-export reporting finds the two command wrappers but also emits 104 issue groups / 252 symbols, reproducing the known noisy surface.
verdict.commandOptionalExports: CommandSeparator and CommandLoading are genuinely unconsumed in the current tree. Each has exactly three structural/text sites: cmdk alias import, local exported declaration, and named barrel re-export. Neither has a client, test, CT, or story consumer. The live command palette uses Command plus other named siblings and renders its loading fallback as a CommandGroup with text.
verdict.repair: No tool repair is needed. Keep pnpm ast/orphan-ratchet as the symbol-unused authority and keep Knip's entry-export behavior documented. Do not enable includeEntryExports globally. The two command rows remain manual optional sealed-surface candidates: preserve if their future public availability is intentional, or delete as a complete owner-ruled cleanup; their unused classification itself is supported.

liveLensMatrix.compoundMemberBehavior: TypeScript parses <UI.Button /> as PropertyAccessExpression UI.Button, which is one of swallowed's recognized spelled-member shapes. Current BaseDrawer.Root compound usage is a named alias import from @base-ui/react, not an @orb/ui namespace consumer.

liveLensMatrix.status: same shared liveness supports candidate verdict
liveLensMatrix.evidence: The individual dead command was not repeated because rot already built the same liveness substrate. For CommandSeparator and CommandLoading, rot/orphans plus the two-method negative sweep supplies the candidate evidence; no @public-family marker exists on either declaration.

clientgap requires a declaration to be consumed by server production and absent from client production, with AppRouter provenance subtraction. Its default scope is contracts and *View/*Summary. An unconsumed UI export cannot satisfy usedServerProd, so it cannot create these command findings.

liveLensMatrix.status: expected file-level clean, not symbol proof
liveLensMatrix.denominator: 367 UI TS/TSX files; 1 declaration file skipped
liveLensMatrix.evidence: Production entries derive from the package export map, so the command barrel and its re-exported implementation are file-reachable even when individual exports are unused. Treating this zero as export liveness would be a false clean.
Both command names appear as unused in packages/ui/src/primitives/command/index.ts and command.tsx when --include-entry-exports is enabled; the default focused run reports none.

consumerShapes.namedAndJsx: Command, Button, Dialog, Icon and many siblings have named subpath imports followed by ordinary JSX uses; AST marks the origin declaration PUBLIC at the import edge regardless of whether the value is rendered directly, placed in a registry, or passed as a prop.
consumerShapes.aliases: Three current client aliases are found structurally and textually; NumberField's origin is PUBLIC, proving local binding spelling does not fork identity.
consumerShapes.registries: Icon component and curated icon values are imported through @orb/ui/icons and then stored in contribution/registry shapes or rendered via <Icon icon={...}>; imports retain liveness independent of the later value shape.
consumerShapes.barrels: packages/ui/src/primitives/command/index.ts is a named re-export barrel. Liveness follows getExportedDeclarations to command.tsx while correctly treating the re-export itself as pass-through rather than consumption.
consumerShapes.ctAndStories: CT imports enter usedTest and become TEST-ONLY when there is no production import. Story and fixture imports are therefore not lost or promoted to production API.
consumerShapes.namespaceAndCompound: No current @orb/ui namespace consumer exists. If introduced, the whole exported module errs alive; swallowed examines dot, optional-dot, string-element, destructured, and JSX compound property spellings to recover unspelled siblings.

orphanHistory.liveBehavior: TOKEN_POLARITY_ARMS is live. Chart fallback colors and Shiki theme colors index it with exact generated literal keys, allowing TypeScript to infer the key without a PolarityTokenPath annotation. Current tests and tooling also inspect the map directly. TokenPath and SnappedTokenPath have explicit generic/test consumers; only the polarity companion type lacks one.
orphanHistory.documentation: No docs/history occurrence. Current audit receipts preserve it as a generated public contract because deleting only the type would make this generated map surface asymmetric; that is an API-shape ruling, not consumption evidence.
orphanHistory.verdict: The type is genuinely unused, while its value map is live and replaced any need for an explicit annotation through literal-key inference. Preserve if the generator intentionally guarantees a named key type for every generated map; otherwise remove the generator line and generated declaration together.

nextSmallestCompleteActions: No AST or Knip implementation change is justified by this audit.

Keep CommandSeparator and CommandLoading in the owner-decision bucket if the sealed UI surface intentionally offers optional cmdk wrappers; otherwise remove each declaration, props export, and barrel export together and run the command primitive checks plus scoped AST receipts.
If a future @orb/ui namespace import lands, run swallowed ui beside apisurface before accepting PUBLIC classifications from that module.
limitations: No broad suite was run; this was source/config inspection plus targeted read-only lenses and structural controls.
The worktree is shared and dirty; the report is a snapshot at the named HEAD with concurrent uncommitted edits visible during inspection.
The individual dead command was intentionally not rerun after the scoped rot pass because both use the same liveness substrate and the parent requested no repeated full-corpus passes.
